integrity: Entire count-domain theorem proved by algebra and root comparison, with a standalone exact-rational checker as supplementary evidence. No independent validation or historical priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for a specific zero modification of Poisson–Bilal counts, not all two-geometric convolution models. Its source count law is a special case of the previously known two-geometric Newton convolution. Historical priority remains provisional; one relevant 2007 paper was accessible only as an abstract and its exact potential implications have not been checked in full.
title: Sharp zero-deflation boundary for infinite divisibility of Poisson–Bilal counts
